scripts.dev: corepack pnpm build:packages && corepack pnpm --filter @jail-atlas/web dev
scripts.test: corepack pnpm build:packages && corepack pnpm -r --if-present test:unit && corepack pnpm test:production-smoke
scripts.test:unit: corepack pnpm build:packages && corepack pnpm -r --if-present test:unit
scripts.test:e2e: corepack pnpm build:packages && corepack pnpm --filter @jail-atlas/web test:e2e
scripts.test:a11y: corepack pnpm build:packages && corepack pnpm --filter @jail-atlas/web test:a11y
scripts.check: corepack pnpm format:check && corepack pnpm lint && corepack pnpm typecheck && corepack pnpm test:unit
scripts.ingest: corepack pnpm build:packages && corepack pnpm --filter @jail-atlas/ingest-worker start
